hypothesis: A canonically aligned, scheduled U.S. cash-session exact-trade source can restore SPCX evaluation without changing strategy behavior when exact and combined trade gaps remain per-bar provenance, future receipts are excluded, and both the current opening and prior cash close fail closed when unresolved.
decision: The repair is implemented and passes focused, historical-parity, frozen-gap, provider/config, and TUI validation. Retain it as a report-only worktree candidate. Do not restart the active V58 backend while BRENTOIL and SP500 remain open. Require one future cash-open observation, a fresh final prestart bundle, flat/order-free reconciliation, and an explicit restart transaction before cutover.
falsifier: Reject or revise the candidate if a future scheduled cash-open remains technically unavailable despite complete required evidence; if any opening or prior-close gap reaches an eligible entry; if a complete-window signal, target, stop, exit, risk, sizing, or decision time differs; if the cursor duplicates or advances without an observed scheduled bar; or if post-cutover runtime, venue, protection, fingerprint, or TUI reconciliation fails.
limitations: No future cash-open boundary has yet been observed with the repaired report-only path.
The active runtime still uses the already-loaded pre-repair implementation and must not be hot-restarted while positions remain open.
Two unrelated repository tests remain red, so repository-wide all-green status is not established.
0xArchive remains validation-only and is not an automatic live data merge.
Technical availability and historical behavior preservation do not establish positive live expectancy or trade frequency.
